translation: At this place, Jivandasji Maharaj first set eyes on and met Guru Gopaldasji. Gopaldasji was returning from someone's memorial rite (karaj) when he met Jivanji. This Keslu-ba is the village today known as Kesru, near Bharuch. When a meeting with one's future guru takes place even before he formally becomes one's guru, that meeting place is considered worthy of remembrance. Thus Keslu-ba is a place of merit (punya sthali).
